summary: Francesco Cognetta, born about 1771 in Italy, father of Nicola Cognetta; John's maternal 4th-great-grandfather.
bio: Francesco Cognetta was born about 1771 in Italy, probably at Dasà in the Vibo Valentia area. With his wife Domenica Malvaso (1781-1848) he was the father of Nicola Cognetta. He is John's maternal 4th-great-grandfather.
openQuestions: Dasà civil records 1809+ (Nicola's marriage act would name his parents)
